summary:
Developed by HippocrAstro, a team of undergraduate multidisciplinary team from Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS), AstroVital is an autonomous, closed-loop medical decision-support platform designed for astronauts across spacecraft, space stations, rovers, and planetary habitats.


Deep-space crews face NASA’s five human spaceflight hazards—space radiation, isolation, distance from Earth, altered gravity, and hostile closed environments—while communication blackouts prevent real-time triage from Earth flight surgeons. Using a Gather–Evaluate–Act workflow, AstroVital ingests vital signs, ultrasound/camera inputs, and live NASA DONKI solar-storm telemetry, mapping them onto an interactive, clickable 3D Spatial Bio-Twin benchmarked against NASA Human Research Program (HRP) standards.


To ensure non-medical crew members can act rapidly under pressure, AstroVital features color-coded risk alerts, dynamic trend charts, plain-English diagnostic explanations with step-by-step recovery protocols, gamified daily health routines, and a hands-free AR Visor Mode equipped with a Push-to-Talk Clinical SI (Super Intelligence) assistant.


By closing the diagnostic gap when medical help is millions of kilometers away, AstroVital safeguards crew health and mission autonomy in deep space while offering a scalable blueprint for remote telemedicine and preventive care on Earth.
details:
AstroVital is an autonomous, closed-loop clinical decision-support and spatial health platform built for long-duration missions across spacecraft, space stations, rovers, and lunar/Martian bases. Built around a Gather–Evaluate–Act architecture, AstroVital operates locally without relying on real-time ground control during deep-space communication blackouts while automatically ingesting live NASA DONKI space-weather alerts whenever telemetry links are active.

Astronauts log or stream core vitals (heart rate, blood pressure, core body temperature, SpO2, blood glucose, sleep, and mood) alongside portable ultrasound scans and radiation dosimetry. AstroVital immediately maps these metrics onto an interactive 3D Spatial Bio-Twin and a hands-free AR Visor Mode, benchmarked against NASA Human Research Program (HRP) and NASA-STD-3001 standards—generating plain-English health summaries, numbered recovery steps, and audit-ready Earth Flight Surgeon uplink packets.

  • Caption: Single-Screen Triage & 3D Spatial Bio-Twin: Displays live crew readiness (100% Optimal), a 4-step daily prevention plan, live NASA DONKI solar-storm warnings (CME 804 km/s), and a clickable 3D anatomical skeleton synced to real-time pulse (66 bpm) and organ vitals.

How It Works – Key Technical & Spatial Innovations

  • Interactive 3D Anatomical Skeleton & Spatial Bio-Twin
    Instead of overwhelming fatigued crews with raw spreadsheets, AstroVital renders a real-time 3D holographic skeleton with active circulatory and nervous system overlays. Crew members click directly on any organ system (neuro-ocular, cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, immune) to inspect spaceflight hazards, physiological mechanisms, and targeted treatments. Every metric is evaluated against NASA-STD-3001 thresholds and mapped to instant visual color-coding (Green = Nominal, Amber = Advisory, Red = Critical Intervention).
  • Hands-Free Spatial AR Visor Mode & Push-to-Talk Clinical SI:
    To support astronauts during active cabin maintenance, rover excursions, and suited tasks without looking down at a console, AR Mode projects a translucent, zero-flicker telemetry HUD directly into the astronaut’s field of view inside the spacecraft module. It integrates a Push-to-Talk Multimodal Clinical SI (Hold to Speak, powered by Open Weight Model) for hands-free voice triage and ultrasound image screening (detecting deep vein thrombosis and optic nerve sheath swelling).

Caption: Spatial AR Visor Mode & Push-to-Talk Clinical SI: Overlays essential vitals and health status directly inside the astronaut's spacecraft visor view, paired with a Push-to-Talk Clinical SI Flight Surgeon for hands-free voice guidance during mission tasks.

  • Closed-Loop Gather–Evaluate–Act Clinical Engine & Live NASA DONKI Integration:
    Continuously ingests live Solar Flare (FLR), Coronal Mass Ejection (CME), and Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) data from the NASA DONKI API alongside Lead II ECG waveforms and biomarkers. When an anomaly is detected, AstroVital triggers one-click countermeasure dispatch (such as lower-body negative pressure, venous thigh cuffs, ARED resistance workouts, or storm-shelter relocation).

Caption: Gather–Evaluate–Act Clinical Workflow: Links live Lead II ECG and vital waveforms (left) with NASA-STD-3001 readiness scoring (center) and one-click countermeasure dispatch (right) for optic nerve sheath distension (6.4 mm) and incoming CME alerts.

  • Zero-Clutter Contextual Briefing, Mission Guide & Gamified Streak System:
    Keeps the main dashboard streamlined to critical readings while offering tap-to-reveal metric explanations, an interactive Guided Tour, a Mission Operations Troubleshooting Tree, and a gamified Protocol Streak Calendar (21-day streak) to sustain daily health habits across multi-year missions.

Caption: Gamified Crew Readiness & Adherence Calendar: Sustains multi-year mission discipline by tracking consecutive protocol streaks and color-coding daily ARED workouts, check-ins, and advisory logs.

Simulated Mission Case Study – Deep-Space Transit Anomaly

To validate AstroVital’s autonomous triage during a 20-minute Earth-to-Mars communication blackout:

  • Baseline Scenario (Day 142 Mars Transit): Following a NASA DONKI CME alert (804 km/s) and cabin workload spike, crew telemetry drifted to elevated heart rate (112 BPM), core temperature (38.1 °C), declining SpO2 (92%), and elevated cumulative radiation (114.5 mSv).
  • AstroVital Triage & Intervention: The 3D Bio-Twin flagged cardiovascular and thermal stress in Amber/Red, immediately generating a plain-English 4-step protocol (1. Cease strenuous workload → 2. Ingest 500 mL electrolyte solution → 3. Engage liquid-cooling loop & move sleep station behind water wall → 4. Re-verify vitals in 10 minutes).
  • Outcome: Executing the dispatched countermeasures restored HR to 76 BPM, core temperature to 36.9 °C, and SpO2 to 98% within 25 minutes—generating a structured Earth Flight Surgeon telemetry packet without ground intervention.

Key Benefits

  • Autonomous Emergency Triage: Equips non-physician astronauts to detect and treat silent spaceflight risks (SANS, deep vein thrombosis, acute radiation exposure) during deep-space communication delays.
  • Zero-Jargon Cognitive Relief: Replaces overwhelming medical tables with plain-English health summaries, visual 3D anatomy, and hands-free AR overlays.
  • Offline-First Resilience: Runs locally on spacecraft/habitat compute so medical guidance never fails if Earth communications drop.
  • Low-Mass Preventive Focus: Prioritizes behavioral, hydration, lighting, and exercise countermeasures over heavy medical hardware—saving critical launch mass.

Scalability & Commercial Roadmap

Built by HippocrAstro (spanning Electrical Engineering, Network Computing, and Finance at Universiti Malaysia Sarawak — UNIMAS), AstroVital is architected to scale across three commercial phases:

  • Phase 1 — Commercial Space & Analog Habitats (Years 1–2): Modular per-seat SaaS licensing for private space stations, analog lunar/Mars research bases, and commercial astronaut training providers.
  • Phase 2 — Remote & Extreme Terrestrial Environments (Years 2–3): Deploying the lightweight, offline-first diagnostic engine to offshore oil rigs, maritime vessels, polar research bases, and rural clinics across Sarawak/Borneo where specialist doctors are unavailable.
  • Phase 3 — Consumer Preventive Health & Aging Care (Years 3+): Microgravity accelerates bone density loss, cardiovascular deconditioning, and balance decline—mirroring aging and sedentary chronic diseases on Earth. AstroVital’s 3D Bio-Twin and gamified daily routines scale naturally into consumer wellness and elderly remote patient monitoring.

Intended Impact

  • Enabling Safe Human Expansion Beyond LEO: Directly mitigates all five NASA Human Spaceflight Hazards (space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile closed environments), empowering small crews to operate safely on the Moon and Mars.
  • Closing Healthcare Gaps on Earth (UN SDG 3 & SDG 9): Demonstrates how space-grade offline diagnostics, plain-language triage, and visual Bio-Twins can democratize preventive healthcare for underserved rural and aging populations worldwide.

Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Data Sources

  • Software & Stack: Built with Python, PySide6, Three.js / WebGL (3D Anatomical Skeleton Bio-Twin & Spacecraft AR Visor HUD), Cloudflare Workers (live web deployment at astrovital.hippocrastro.workers.dev), SQLite (local telemetry persistence), Open-Weight Model (Push-to-Talk Clinical SI & ultrasound screening), and NASA DONKI API (live space weather).
  • Reference Standards & Datasets: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) risk models, NASA-STD-3001 Spaceflight Human-System Standards, and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) ISS life sciences datasets.
  • SI Tools Disclosure: Claude assisted with front-end UI refactoring and code prototyping, while Open-Weight Model powered the in-app multimodal Clinical SI co-pilot and helped synthesize NASA/CSA physiological guidelines.
